headword: {公明正大|こうめいせいだい}
gloss: fair and square; open and aboveboard

definitions.gloss: fair and square; open and aboveboard; impartial
definitions.explanation: Describing actions, conduct, or character that are completely fair, transparent, and without hidden motives.

examples.japanese: {公明正大|こうめいせいだい}な{選挙|せんきょ}を{行|おこな}う。
examples.english: To conduct a fair and transparent election.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{公明正大|こうめいせいだい}な{人柄|ひとがら}で{知|し}られている。
examples.english: He is known for his fair and upright character.

examples.japanese: {公明正大|こうめいせいだい}に{物事|ものごと}を{進|すす}める。
examples.english: To proceed with things openly and fairly.

notes:
YOJIJUKUGO (FOUR-CHARACTER IDIOM)

FORMATION:
{公明|こうめい} (fair and open) + {正大|せいだい} (upright and grand)
- {公明|こうめい}: fair, open, impartial
- {正大|せいだい}: upright, proper, grand

GRAMMAR PATTERNS:
・{公明正大|こうめいせいだい}な + noun ({態度|たいど}, {選挙|せんきょ}, {審査|しんさ})
・{公明正大|こうめいせいだい}に + verb (adverbial use)

COLLOCATIONS:
・{公明正大|こうめいせいだい}な{態度|たいど} - fair and open attitude
・{公明正大|こうめいせいだい}な{判断|はんだん} - impartial judgment
・{公明正大|こうめいせいだい}な{取引|とりひき} - fair dealing

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・{清廉潔白|せいれんけっぱく} - pure and clean (emphasis on integrity)
・フェア - fair (loanword)
